verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit docs describe a full compute toolchain (compiler, runtime, libraries, Nsight profilers, CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python) for desktop GPUs. The RTX 5070 family page promotes building with GPU-optimized SDKs and PyTorch on RTX PCs, and a community spec discussion cites 8960 CUDA cores. However, no cited CUDA document explicitly lists the RTX 5070 Ti or Blackwell consumer compute capability as a supported target. missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing naming this part, and hands-on corroboration of CUDA workloads running on the 5070 Ti.
